title: Deck editor revision and active-slot integrity

rules.collection: Deck editing never consumes or grants collection cards
rules.activeDeck: at most one active slot per player

scenarios: Stale revision rejected by changeDeck, renameDeck and activateDeck with full SQLite snapshot unchanged
Editing an active Deck below 20 Main Deck cards deactivates only that slot
Activating slot 2 deactivates slot 1; incomplete slot 3 cannot displace the active Deck
Discord deckMessage/deckCardMessage payloads validate and custom IDs remain owner-bound
A card present only in another player's collection cannot be inspected through the first player's Deck editor
environment: Temporary SQLite database; test fixtures inserted only into the isolated test database; no production database or player inventory touched.

certification.reason: This is a Deck editor/data-integrity suite, not a card behavior certification.

limitations: No live Discord API/token interaction; actual builders and payload validation are exercised offline.
No production deployment or persistent database mutation.
Full Engine Validation and Extended Soak remain separate CI gates.
